headline: Fullscreen. Live Chat.
prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ads-marketing. Edit the attached exact cream editorial festival promotional tile for YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen.
Replace its two main headline sentences with exactly:
"Fullscreen."
"Live Chat."
The first word is Fullscreen, spelled F-u-l-l-s-c-r-e-e-n, one continuous word with NO internal space and no line break. First line in the existing elegant bold vermilion serif; second line in the existing bold charcoal grotesk with capital L and C. Preserve both periods. These two sentences must be the ONLY text in the artwork. Delete the former Keep the moment / Keep the chat phrases completely.
Keep the warm cream field, restrained thin red rule, generous elegant editorial spacing, and the large original illustrated sunset music-festival video beneath the headlines. Preserve its stage, sunset, anonymous crowd, orange lighting and ONE clean charcoal live-chat overlay at the right INSIDE the video, with avatar symbols, symbolic message bars and outlined input/send symbols. This is original conceptual artwork, no real creator or actual UI claim.
Prominent legible headline at 220 x 140. Maintain compact landscape ratio 11:7, ideally 1760 pixels wide by 1120 pixels tall; not a panorama. All text comfortably within the upper field, at least 5% margins, no clipping. Recompose only if needed for beautiful proportions, never stretch or crop the art.
No added labels, brands, official logos, feature badges, tiny copy, extra panels, room, monitor or watermark. Preserve warm sophisticated live-entertainment design.
revisionPrompt:
Recompose this exact cream festival advertisement onto a COMPACT 11:7 landscape canvas, 1760 pixels wide by 1120 pixels tall. The current panorama is too wide. The final must have width divided by height = 1.5714, NOT 2.5:1. Make the picture taller. Preserve the identity, headline content, sunset festival subject and chat.
Layout: cream editorial headline area occupies the upper 35% of the compact tile. Large red bold serif "Fullscreen." on one continuous line, charcoal bold sans-serif "Live Chat." on the second line. These are the ONLY words. Exact spelling Fullscreen is one word, capital F, then lowercase letters; Live Chat has one space. Both periods stay. Keep text at least 5% from all sides.
The lower 60% is one landscape sunset concert artwork. Original anonymous crowd, orange stage lighting, huge sunset. The ONE dark chat overlay must be at the right INSIDE this artwork, with three circle avatars/message-bar rows, native-looking input bar and send arrow. Ensure the panel and its input fit fully inside this lower artwork. Cream border and thin red editorial rule remain.
Use recomposition, not stretching or cutting away content. Maintain the warm cream, vermilion and charcoal print design. No other words, badge, new object, logo, monitor or watermark. Compact store-listing tile readable when reduced to 220 x 140.
